title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2+PARKING SPACE - ASL COMPLEX, FORMER PROFARMA - XHAMLLIKU
description_en: - Net Area: 95.1 m² - Common Area: 13.22 m² - Total Area: 108.32 m² Organization: • Living room together with the kitchen area, • 2 Bedrooms, • 2 Toilets • Storage • Balcony The apartment is located on the fourth floor, the third building of the complex and has a South orientation. Each building has its own entrance and elevator. The complex has functional service facilities on the first floors. The property is sold together with a 17 m² parking space included in the price. It is equipped with Ownership Certificates. The location offers quick and easy access to the main arteries of the city, connecting directly to the Center and Ring of Tirana through Sadik Petrela and Xhanfize Keko streets.
